title: Spike hit with low score wraps score to ~65136 instead of flooring at 0
observed: Score was 100 after collecting a coin. Stepping onto spikes at (3,3) cost a life (lives 3->2, respawn at (1,1)) but the score became 65136 (HUD 'Score 65136'), which equals 100 - 500 wrapped modulo 65536.
expected: Spikes subtract 500 points but the score is floored at 0 and never goes negative, so the score should read 0 after the hit.
